svg.aria-label: Hello, I'm Aksan: a final-year Computer Science & Engineering student at BRAC University in Dhaka. My work lives between two worlds: AI research and engineering, where I study how large models remember, adapt and fail; and the web, where I build full-stack products people can actually use. I like understanding a system all the way down, which is why, after hours, I am writing an operating system of my own.
